notes: A well-documented educational ML pipeline (NYC taxi tip prediction) with etl/training/inference layering, a utils abstraction layer, Docker per-component commands, and S3-backed versioned artifacts. External contributors dockerized it and added an EDA notebook via reviewed PRs. Honest about scope: 'first pass' logic, only io is unit-tested, and the stated F1 of 0.716 is the one claim not verifiable from the snapshot.
